name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private research: tram stop using a STREET profile measured with paths in both directions.
description: Revision 11 adds a separate UM Bidirectional Stop (Test). It combines the accepted direct midpoint terminal binding from revision 9 with the exact mixed-mode STREET profile measured in direction-probe row B: forwardOnly=false, needsReservation=true, and paths in both directions for TRAM, ELECTRIC_TRAM, TRAM_TRACK and ELECTRIC_TRAM_TRACK. Only that isolated segment behavior is proven. New station placement, complete line routing, native vehicle reversal, passenger access and reservation safety still need testing. Place two NEW bidirectional stops on a separate test save, connect via ordinary electric tramtrack and inspect diagnostics. Existing stations and the measured profile are unchanged. No hidden loop, duplicate reverse curves, automatic commands or requirement for a tram/rail transition.
